main_body: A leafy fern fan in a small tapered clay pot. The pot is the solid base and the fern fills the upper half.
top_band: The pot has a 1-row light peach rim (#f8c090, row 10) under a dark outline row 9. It is followed directly by a mid-brown front (rows 11-12), with no ellipse and no visible soil. The foliage is a green mass with a lighter highlight patch and no separate top and front bands.
evidence: In the column through the pot, only a 1-row peach rim (row 9 outline, row 10 peach) separates the outline from the brown pot front (rows 11-13). That is a rim-only top. The pot mouth is not drawn as an ellipse and no soil or opening can be seen from above. The pot body reads as a flat front view, so this is the rim-only failure from the guide.

style.evidence: The greens carry about 4 steps (dark, mid, light, highlight) and the pot about 4 browns, with tinted dark green and brown outlines. The piece has only 12 distinct colours, against 427 and 567 for the references. The leaves have no clump or grain texture, and the pot is a smooth gradient with no grain dots. It is shallower and flatter than the Beodeul trees at the same scale, so it would look thinner beside them.
